title: Swing: EDT discipline and authority separation
summary: Wire UI Swing keeps widget mutation on the Event Dispatch Thread and keeps business/network authority out of listeners. A listener captures local values and queues UI_ACTION; it does not call ooRexx, Queue Fabric, JMS/network code, or wait for a server reply.
invariants: Swing component access is marshalled to or asserted on the EDT.
Do not block the EDT on network, JMS, server, or application logic.
Presentation state is not permission/business-state authority.
correct: Preflight semantic work before committing the widget mutation on the EDT.
Restore interrupt status when InterruptedException is caught at the EDT marshalling boundary.
Keep failure scope local; ordinary rendering faults must not become process exits.
